claim: You can enable fast snapshot restore (FSR) for public snapshots and for all private snapshots shared with your account, and only your account is billed for the FSR of a shared snapshot.
note: Registrar 22: the contradicting FAQ answer (ebs-faq-fsr-own-snapshots-only, 'FSR cannot be applied to shared snapshots') was rejected; the user guide quota sentence (ebs-fsr-5-snapshots-per-region) agrees with this fact.
